description: Self-hosted bot messenger and PWA with a TypeScript SDK, GraphQL and WebSocket server, SQLite storage, and runner-agnostic integration testing.
rules: Use @appercot/chat for bot applications and @appercot/test for integration tests.
Use environment variables for credentials; never hard-code owner passwords, bot tokens, or test control tokens.
Only the dedicated test CLI may enable fixture seeding and the destructive test control API; never enable them in production.
Use public package entry points and documented APIs rather than server internals or generated web modules.
With ackOnError set to false, make event side effects idempotent because failed events can be redelivered.
Back up SQLite and the corresponding local or S3 media together, including DATA_DIR/totp.key when two-factor authentication is used.
Use registered data-test-id selectors for browser tests instead of translated text or CSS layout selectors.
Treat docs/guide as current usage documentation and docs/superpowers as historical design material, not supported API contracts.
